answer: Splitting into 4 separate vaults requires a separate funded relic account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The crystal explorer shows the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the willow binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 403 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
